## Control probes 
The idea is to use the control probes to apply batch correction, the control probes in 850k Epic array are inherit from the 450k array. 
We want to run PCA on control probes and the resulting PCs are used as linear predictors of the regression model.
Here I followed the approach from Corneel, he took it from Lehne et al 2015.

The following code is modified from script 1_intensities.sh, written by Benjamin Lehne (Imperial College London) and Alexander Drong (Oxford University) and publish in Lehne et al. 2015 Genome Biology 16:37  doi:10.1186/s13059-015-0600-x

Here is explained:
https://genomebiology.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s13059-015-0600-x

# Lehne script to performe PCA

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library("missMethyl") # Contains annot850K

```

## Surrogates variables using ENmix

```{r}
sva <- ctrlsva(sf.rgSet_ext, npc = 1)
df.sva <- as.data.frame(sva)
print(dim(df.sva))


file = "../../results/02_PCA_ctrl_probes/ENmix_sva_all_donors.csv"
write.csv(x = sva, file = file, row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pheno.data <- data.frame(sf.rgSet_ext@colData)

pheno.data$plate.nr <- factor(sub(
  ".*?(plate_\\d+).*",
  "\\1",
  gsub(
    "(?i)[ _]?[Pp]late (\\d+)",
    "plate_\\1",
    as.character(pheno.data$Sample_Plate),
    perl = TRUE
  )
 ))

pheno.data$Array <-  as.factor(pheno.data$Sentrix_Position)
pheno.data$Slide <-  as.factor(pheno.data$Sentrix_ID)
pheno.data$Isolation_day <-  as.factor(pheno.data$Isolation_day)


ctrlprobes.scores = df.sva
colnames(ctrlprobes.scores) = paste(colnames(ctrlprobes.scores), '_cp', sep='')


if (identical(rownames(ctrlprobes.scores),rownames(pheno.data)) == FALSE) {
    print("WARNING: rownames pca do not match rownames phenotypes")
    }
  
n.pcs <- 7
my.pees <- matrix(ncol = n.pcs, nrow = 3)
colnames(my.pees) <- as.character(paste0(rep("PC",n.pcs),seq(1:n.pcs)))
rownames(my.pees) <- c("Array","Slide", "Isolation_day")

for (i in 1:n.pcs)  {
  my.pees[,i] <- summary(
    aov(ctrlprobes.scores[,i] ~ Array + Slide + Isolation_day,
        data = pheno.data))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1:3]
}

log.pees <- -log10(my.pees)

```

# Plot heatmap
```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gplots)

selcol <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9,"YlOrRd"))

heatmap.2(
  log.pees,
  Rowv = NA,
  Colv = "Rowv", 
  margins = c(5, 8),
  cexRow = 0.9,
  col = selcol(256),
  trace = "none",
  density.info="none"
)

```
